We also link each DTAQ firm to CRSP data using the linking table provided by DTAQ. We
remove observations with missing data and impose no other survival criteria except where
noted. Our final sample comprises nearly 7,000 firms and 15 million daily observations of
spreads and Amihud. The Appendix defines all of our variables and their sources.
